Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (100%) covering course_rating, PDGA-style player_rating, WebSocket /api/ws/rounds and /api/ws/leagues (hello, score_update broadcast, announcement broadcast, invalid-token/non-member close), auto-pair (director + 403), CSV exports (standings.csv + ledger.csv with proper headers and ?auth= query support), and player profile endpoint. critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1296 lines - exceeds 700 LOC guideline. Split into routers: auth, leagues, rounds/scoring, ledger, clubhouse, ws, csv_exports, player_profile.
RoundScorecard.jsx uses window.confirm() for auto-pair confirmation - not testable in headless mode without page.on('dialog', d.accept()). Consider using an in-app confirmation modal for consistency.
useWebSocket hook reconnects every 3s on close with no exponential backoff - can hammer server on persistent auth failure. Add backoff + max-retries.
StandingsTab polls every 12s (setInterval) in addition to relying on parent for realtime - if switched fully to WS, remove polling to save requests.
CSV endpoints (standings.csv, ledger.csv) accept ?auth={token} as a query parameter - this leaks tokens into browser history and server logs. Consider a short-lived signed download URL instead.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (RoundScorecard crash): The auto-pair feature was added referencing leagueFormat and isDirector variables that were never defined in the component - a straightforward missing-derivation bug. React caught it as a component-level error and rendered nothing. Fix: fetch /api/leagues/{id} during load() and derive `leagueFormat = league?.format` and `isDirector = league?.is_director`. Bug 2 (course_rating not persisted): The Round Pydantic model (server.py:118) uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and did not include course_rating as a field, so when create_league did `Round(..., course_rating=float(rating))`, pydantic silently dropped it before insert_one. All round records in DB missed the field. Fix: add `course_rating: Optional[float] = None` to Round model.
